This update makes the Linux importer safer and adds Simplified Chinese to the launcher.

The import command now checks the package, app and theme names it reads from your trial before handing them to pacman, yay or Flatpak. It only runs the system's own tools, so a script with the same name in your trial's `~/.local/bin` can't stand in for one, and it never follows a link on the trial disk outside the trial. If you already imported your own trial with v0.7.0, there's nothing to redo.

The list of what to bring over now says that everything checked comes along, so pressing Enter is all most people need to do.

When Windows is set to Simplified Chinese, the launcher's About and update screens, first-launch questions and Settings section titles now show in Chinese. Thanks to @Dazzle-sys for the translation.
